title: Wellness — sommeil, HRV, FC repos, poids
description: Bien-être journalier depuis core.daily_wellness et core.sleep_session (schéma 006). Colonnes nullable (COMMENT ON TABLE core.daily_wellness) : les trous ne sont pas des zéros.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.resting_hr AS "FC repos (bpm)", w.hrv_last_night_avg AS "HRV nuit (ms)" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date

SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.weight_kg AS "Poids (kg)" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND w.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date

panels.title: Phases de sommeil
panels.description: core.sleep_session est clé par la date de RÉVEIL (wake_date) et non de coucher (COMMENT ON TABLE core.sleep_session).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.wake_date::timestamp AS time, s.deep_s AS "Profond (s)", s.light_s AS "Léger (s)", s.rem_s AS "Paradoxal (s)", s.awake_s AS "Éveil (s)" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(s.wake_date) ORDER BY s.wake_date
SELECT s.wake_date::timestamp AS time, s.sleep_score AS "Score de sommeil" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(s.wake_date) ORDER BY s.wake_date

SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.body_battery_high AS "Body Battery max", w.body_battery_low AS "Body Battery min", w.avg_stress AS "Stress moyen" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date
